title: Christmas Markets in Mitte - Quick Summary
items: **The walk:** Sophienstraße, Alexanderplatz, the Rotes Rathaus, the Humboldt Forum and Gendarmenmarkt sit on one line, about 3 km and 40 minutes on foot.
**Weekdays:** the four big markets all close at **22:00**, so walk them east to west and finish at Gendarmenmarkt.
**Weekends:** Sophienstraße opens on **Advent weekends only** and closes at 20:00 on Saturday, 19:00 on Sunday, so start there.
**Late finish:** Gendarmenmarkt stays open until **23:00 on Friday and Saturday**.
**Entry:** only Gendarmenmarkt charges, **2 euros**, free on weekdays 11:00 to 14:00 and for under 12s.
**No Hackescher Markt market in 2026:** use the station as your way in, not as a stop.
**My move:** set the time you really leave, start with the market that closes first and keep Gendarmenmarkt for last.
